selection_basis: Distinct authored development worlds and verifier-defined answers; no selection using model failures or hinted successes.

pairs.answer_equivalence: same exact rational pairwise preference probability
pairs.limitations: Both positive worlds use the same cancellation family. This checks data flow and different answers, not held-out structural generalization. Numeric and distribution-size shifts must be balanced in a future donor policy.

confirmation: unmaterialized; a new independently held-out family cohort and prospective disjoint answer-pool recipe remain required
